description: GROUND_CONCERN SIX KINDS, Path 2 (GROUND_CONCERN_SIX_KINDS_PREREG.md, GROUND_CONCERN_SIX_KINDS_RESULTS.md): a promoted `knowledge` StandingConcern was MEASURED to fall through jabberwock_daemon._concern_tick's generic induce_concern/ground_concern fallback into the SAME inert comprehend_describe_directive_<tag> rule A25 found for prog_read (reported grounded:true, no record anywhere). `_concern_tick` now routes a StandingConcern of this kind (whenever its own `pipeline` attr is NOT 'experiment' -- the experiment sub-case was already correctly wired via _promote_relations_for_concern's existing knowledge-eligible conversation bundle and is left untouched) DIRECTLY into domains.knowledge_growth.work_on_knowledge_gap, which re-attempts the EXISTING self-heal chain (WorldAdapter.answer_about / ground_unknowns, CLAUDE.md's own 'Knowledge gaps self-heal' section) instead of inventing a new mechanism. `_process_knowledge_standing` records a MECHANICAL outcome datum (knowledge_compose_ok / knowledge_compose_reason) onto the StandingConcern -- never a decision there. THIS seed's two rules read that datum: `resolve_knowledge_gap` (the resolve_code_write_gap precedent) marks the original SelfConcern resolved when the re-attempt genuinely grounded the topic; `note_knowledge_composition_exhausted` (the note_prog_read_composition_exhausted precedent) marks the StandingConcern experiments_exhausted with the honest, specific re-attempt-failure reason when it did not. No emitter tool exists for this file (confirmed by grep across tools/*.py) -- hand-authored, the same status code_write_gap.json/prog_read_gap.json already have.
